en.t: “It is not from the cold; it is because I took off the face powder.

units.source_text: 我一钻进被窝，马上就感到一股暖流直窜脚尖。”

en.t: As soon as I crawl under the covers, I feel a warm current rush straight down to my toes.”

units.source_text: 说着，她面对着枕旁的梳妆台照了照镜子。

en.t: As she said this, she turned toward the dressing table beside the pillow and looked in the mirror.
